nodes.rule: branch = 'DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE' if delta >= 100 or transfer_base >= base_bar else 'CONDITIONAL_UW_REVIEW' if delta >= cond_floor and transfer_base >= 200 else 'AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO'
nodes.follows: threshold-comparison banding as in travelplanner:train/easy/0 budget constraint (total held against a bar); each cut thresholds in its own unit: cond_floor is the LIVE answer-set size of birdsql:142 (Pisek household-payment accounts, 32 — an account count on the count-typed delta) and base_bar the LIVE birdsql:192 amount answer (average running-contract loan amount) through the same declared round(/200) policy as the base (= 964 — an amount bar on the amount-typed base); the delta decline cut 100 and the base floor 200 are declared constants, no unit-compatible source counterpart
inputs: cond_floor <- birdsql:142 (live rerun, COUNT of answer rows)
